name: nse-day-trader-skill
description: NSE/BSE port of the Day Trader skill pack for Claude (Indian markets, INR, IST).

plugins.name: nse-day-trader-skill
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading Indian stocks (NSE/BSE): a chart scanner, a news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager with a daily kill switch, a budget manager that counts STT, GST and stamp duty, an order executor (paper by default, Angel One SmartAPI live only after your typed yes), price alerts, a results analyst and a bulk/block deals and insider tracker. Educational only, not investment advice.
